notes.title: She Wasn’t Meant to Feel. She Chose to Fight.
notes.content:
[h3]What if a machine could feel heartbreak? [i]L33na Redpepper[/i] doesn’t just answer that—it weaponizes it.
This isn’t just a cyberpunk revenge tale. It's an exploration of loss, memory, and emotional scars that run deeper than metal.
With detailed environments, responsive combat, and a story that echoes classic sci-fi dramas, you’re in for a uniquely intense ride.
Built with the Unity engine and enhanced with modern shaders and lighting, the game delivers a visual punch while remaining focused on narrative rhythm. L33na is no savior—she’s a question the world never wanted to answer.
For those who love deeply immersive stories with bite, this one is personal.[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: Hardpunch Patch 1.2
notes.content:
This new Hardpunch update introduces new features and new content. It is now possible to reset the saved game information, resetting the backup file.
This update restructures the main updates of the game that were carried out in the last 40 days to bring a new perspective.

New improvements (and bug fixes) will come in the next 30 days
